# Xiaomi 17T Pro Lab (v3.1.0)

[![CI](https://github.com/0thernes/xiaomi-17t-pro-lab/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/0thernes/xiaomi-17t-pro-lab/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-3.1.0-38d4f2)](CHANGELOG.md)
[![Lean 4.35.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lean%204.35.0-75%20constructive%20decls%20%C2%B7%200%20Choice%20%C2%B7%206%20kernels-4ade80)](lean/VerifyAxioms.lean)
[![Oracle](https://img.shields.io/badge/60--digit%20oracle-54%2F54%20pass-0b6bcb)](reference/physics_oracle.py)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT%20%2B%20CC--BY--4.0-a78bfa)](LICENSE)
[![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-active-2ea043)](ROADMAP.md)
[![Pages](https://img.shields.io/badge/demo-GitHub%20Pages-ff6900)](https://0thernes.github.io/xiaomi-17t-pro-lab/)

Forensic silicon-to-quantum hardware workbench, independent 60-digit differential physics oracle, pure Lean 4.35.0 six-kernel formal verification core, and AMS-LaTeX white paper for the **Xiaomi 17T Pro** (`2602EPTC0G`, codename `warhol`) and **MediaTek Dimensity 9500** (`MT6993Z`, TSMC N3P, `140.57 mm²`).

![Xiaomi 17T Pro Lab Social Preview](docs/media/social-preview.png)

- **Live Interactive Workbench:** <https://0thernes.github.io/xiaomi-17t-pro-lab/>
- **Interactive Lean 4.35.0 Proof Blueprint:** <https://0thernes.github.io/xiaomi-17t-pro-lab/blueprint/>
- **Frozen AMS-LaTeX White Paper (Preprint, CC-BY-4.0):** [Donahue_2026_Xiaomi_17T_Pro_Lab.pdf](dist/Donahue_2026_Xiaomi_17T_Pro_Lab.pdf)
- **Permanent Software Heritage Snapshot:** [`swh:1:snp:06ad26ff598cf7d592768bdef08d9de7616cd4e0`](https://archive.softwareheritage.org/swh:1:snp:06ad26ff598cf7d592768bdef08d9de7616cd4e0/) (rev `swh:1:rev:1d8a87126258fa7691715ed753ee7a4f0609cc28`, full visit `2026-11-26T10:54:12Z`)
- **Author:** Alexander Stephen Donahue ([ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648](https://orcid.org/0009-0006-8168-9648)), Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA (`0_0@0thernes.art`)
- **Status:** active

## Quickstart

Node.js `>= 22` is required (zero build step for the web app; optional Python `>= 3.12`, Lean `4.35.0`, and Tectonic for full formal & manuscript reproduction).

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/xiaomi-17t-pro-lab.git
cd xiaomi-17t-pro-lab
npm ci
npm start            # Launches loopback server at http://127.0.0.1:47321/ (with strict CSP & COOP/COEP)
```

Verify the full suite from a clean clone:

```bash
npm run verify:all                                   # Specs schema + 50 Node tests + 8/8 mutants + 3 examples
python reference/physics_oracle.py --check-checksums # 54 differential checks at 60-digit precision + SHA-256 manifests
npm run evals                                        # 9-shard TinyStories-8M WebCrypto/Node SHA-256 + greedy regression
npm run test:smoke                                   # Playwright 19-route phone & desktop E2E smoke
```

## 5-Second Lean 4.35.0 Kernel Verification

```bash
cd lean
lake build XiaomiLabProofs Challenge Solution
lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
lake env leanchecker --fresh XiaomiLabProofs
lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution
# On Linux with bubblewrap (automated in CI across all 6 kernels):
lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
```

All **75 constructive audited declarations** (65 exported theorems across 7 Palomar modules + 10 isolated Palomar comparator targets; 28 zero-axiom) compile cleanly with zero Mathlib, zero `sorry` (outside statement-only `Challenge.lean`), zero `native_decide`, and **zero `Classical.choice`** — strictly within `[propext, Quot.sound]`, paired with live negative kernel & comparator rejection (`scripts/test_negative_lean.py`). See [docs/statement-fidelity.md](docs/statement-fidelity.md), [docs/literature-search-log.md](docs/literature-search-log.md), and [formalization.yaml](formalization.yaml).

## Usage

### Interactive Browser Labs (`10⁻¹ m → 10⁻¹⁵ m`)

Press **`Ctrl+K`** anywhere to jump to any lab, physics solver, live workload, or FCC component. Hover any 3D part to inspect provenance-badged specs; click to focus (`R` resets framing).

| Route                           | Scale          | Live Real-Time Computation                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| :------------------------------ | :------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Phone** (`#/`)                | `10⁻¹ m`       | Interactive 3D Xiaomi 17T Pro with PBR microfacet maps, HyperOS 3 telemetry OLED, Leica triple optics, 7-layer FCC teardown, raycast inspector                                                             |
| **Zoom** (`#/zoom`)             | `10⁻¹→10⁻¹⁵ m` | 8-rung Powers-of-Ten descent: Phone → PCB → MT6993Z PoP → `140.57 mm²` Die → C1-Ultra → FinFET → Si Crystal → Quantum Tunnel / Dirac                                                                       |
| **CPU** (`#/cpu`)               | `28.75 mm²`    | 15-level taxonomy, live Sattolo pointer-chase latency curve, WASM SIMD `f32x4`, COOP/COEP timer isolation, ARMv9.3-A decoder                                                                               |
| **GPU** (`#/gpu`)               | `24.23 mm²`    | 16-level Mali-G1 Ultra MC12 + RTUv2 stack, checked WebGPU/WebGL2 matmul vs Float64 reference, interactive TBDR tile-binner                                                                                 |
| **NPU 990** (`#/npu`)           | `12.60 mm²`    | 14-level 4× MDLA + 2× MVPU + CIM stack, live FP64 vs INT8 vs BitNet 1.58-bit error heatmaps (labeled CPU JS/WASM, not NPU dispatch)                                                                        |
| **RAM & UFS** (`#/memory`)      | `76.8 GB/s`    | MT6993Z + SK hynix `H58GG6AV9H` PoP, live STREAM Triad + 16 MB copy, CS Roofline plot, LLM memory-wall & UFS 4.1 load calculator                                                                           |
| **Thermal PDE** (`#/thermal`)   | `5,500 mm²`    | Live 2D explicit FDTD heat PDE with CFL sub-stepping & smooth closed-loop DVFS (`<= 0.5 s`), FLIR Ironbow shader, 20-minute exact clock (`1,200 s`)                                                        |
| **EUV Litho** (`#/litho`)       | `13.5 nm`      | 2D Fourier partial-coherence EUV simulator (`6T SRAM`, `L-Bend`, `Via0`, `48 nm Lines`) + OPC serifs, 40-pair Mo/Si Bragg transfer matrix (`74.32%`), sub-pixel Poisson shot-noise LER                     |
| **Atom & QED** (`#/transistor`) | `10⁻⁸→10⁻¹⁵ m` | Unitary Crank–Nicolson TDSE (`norm err < 1e-8`), N3P FinFET double-gate $\lambda$, Kronig–Penney bands, Varshni $n_i(T)$, Dirac dispersion                                                                 |
| **Workloads** (`#/work/*`)      | `Live Run`     | 6K PBR stress arena, deterministic 9-shard TinyStories-8M GPT-Neo with exact full-vocab Shannon entropy & Neuralese hooks, 272-neuron Glitchling A-Life, Bloch/CHSH/Mermin-3/Peres–Mermin quantum composer |
| **Versus** (`#/compare`)        | `3-Way`        | Normalized multi-metric scoreboard vs iPhone 18 Pro Max & Galaxy S26 Ultra with strict same-lab attribution                                                                                                |
| **Specs** (`#/specs`)           | `FCC + Die`    | Searchable forensic catalog of 29 FCC/kernel parts, 22 source conflicts with precedence rules, 12 issues, and 7 explicit `UNKNOWN` leaves                                                                  |

### Programmatic Examples (`examples/`)

```bash
node examples/01_euv_and_bragg.mjs
node examples/02_thermal_fdtd_iceloop.mjs
node examples/03_quantum_contextuality.mjs
```

```bash
just reproduce   # Full verification ladder: tests, mutants, examples, 60-digit oracle, evals, bench, stats, Lean 4, LaTeX PDF
just audit       # Build Standard v1.2.0 90-item repository audit
```

## Limitations

- **Zero Mega-Atlas Retirements:** This repository solves **0 / 1,900** open problems in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`.
- **No Browser NPU 990 Dispatch:** All live LLM and quantization workloads run on the visitor's JavaScript CPU thread (or WebGL2), never on MediaTek NPU 990.
- **Unpublished Hardware Leaves Stay `UNKNOWN`:** Nominal battery watt-hours, reverse-wireless wattage, rear glass composition, device UFS lanes, GPU clock, and proprietary TSMC N3P process-kit ground rules remain explicitly `null` / `UNKNOWN`.
- **Not Externally Peer Reviewed:** The AMS-LaTeX white paper is an independent research preprint. See [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md) for the full literal-vs-metaphor boundary table.

# AGENTS.md — Canonical Agent Instructions for `xiaomi-17t-pro-lab`

This file is the single canonical source of project instructions for all coding and research agents (Codex, Claude Code, Gemini/Antigravity, Cursor). Keep under 32 KiB.

## 1. Mission & Epistemic Rules

- **Repository:** `xiaomi-17t-pro-lab` (zero-build static ES-module hardware lab + pure Lean 4.35.0 formal core + AMS-LaTeX white paper for the Xiaomi 17T Pro & MediaTek Dimensity 9500).
- **Author & Affiliation:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648`), Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA (`0_0@0thernes.art`). Do NOT assert `"0thernes LLC"` as affiliation or legal entity.
- **Provenance discipline:** Never invent unpublished Xiaomi 17T Pro or TSMC N3P values (nominal battery Wh, reverse-wireless watts, rear glass, device UFS lane count, GPU clock, N3P fin height/gate length stay `null` / `UNKNOWN`). Every leaf in `data/specs.json` must carry `source` and `status`.
- **Honest scope:** Browser workloads NEVER execute on MediaTek NPU 990; Glitchling A-Life is non-sentient; `0 / 1,900` grand open problems in `unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` are retired by this repository (`docs/mega-atlas-cross-reference.md`).

## 2. Hard Workflow Rules (Build Standard v1.2.0 R1–R8)

- Commit and push directly to `main` (no PRs, no feature branches, no PR templates, no `.github/copilot-instructions.md`).
- Never install git hooks or turn linters/SAST into blocking commit gates (report-only).
- Never track any file larger than 5 MiB (TinyStories-8M FP16 lives as 9 byte-exact shards <= 4.5 MB under `vendor/tinystories/shards/`).
- Classify every audit finding into exactly one of the 10 classes: `bug`, `error`, `issue`, `problem`, `concern`, `dilemma`, `conflict`, `gap`, `hole`, `blindspot`.

## 3. Key Commands (`justfile`)

- `just test` — runs `npm run validate`, `npm test` (50 Node unit/property/metamorphic/EIO/golden tests), and `node scripts/mutate.mjs` (8/8 mutants).
- `just oracle` — runs 60-digit independent Python oracle (`reference/physics_oracle.py --check-checksums`).
- `just evals` — runs deterministic TinyStories-8M regression & entropy eval (`evals/run_tinystories_eval.mjs`).
- `just lean` — builds `lean/XiaomiLabProofs`, `Challenge`, `Solution`, audits 59 axioms (`VerifyAxioms.lean`), and runs `leanchecker --fresh`.
- `just paper` — compiles zero-warning AMS-LaTeX PDF (`dist/Donahue_2026_Xiaomi_17T_Pro_Lab.pdf`) and verifies standalone `dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz`.
- `just audit` — runs Build Standard v1.2.0 90-item repo audit (`scripts/Audit-Repo.ps1` / `scripts/audit-repo.sh`).
- `just reproduce` — runs the entire end-to-end verification pipeline from a clean clone.

## 4. Layout Quick Map

- `src/sim/*.js` — live physical, optical, quantum, thermal, memory, and hardware math solvers (single CODATA source: `src/sim/constants.js`).
- `src/workloads/*.js` — sharded safetensors loader (WebCrypto SHA-256), GPT-Neo forward pass, GPT-2 BPE tokenizer.
- `lean/` — pure Lean 4.35.0 (`module` headers, zero Mathlib) formal core + Palomar `Challenge.lean`/`Solution.lean`.
- `reference/physics_oracle.py` — independent 60-digit `Decimal`/`Fraction` differential oracle.
- `paper/` & `dist/` — AMS-LaTeX white paper, vector figures, frozen PDF, standalone arXiv tarball.
- `CLAIMS.md`, `LIMITATIONS.md`, `REPLICATION.md`, `VERIFICATION.md`, `HARDENING_LOG.md`, `docs/statement-fidelity.md`, `docs/mega-atlas-cross-reference.md`.

Every technical, mathematical, and empirical claim made by `xiaomi-17t-pro-lab` (**v3.1.0**) is assigned a unique ID, an explicit epistemic tier, a concrete verification command, and an explicit falsification condition (**What Would Prove Us Wrong**, Build Standard B04 & B42).

| :------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| **C02**  | Kurnal Dimensity 9500 die area is `10.88 × 12.92 = 140.5696 mm²`, strictly dominating the 4 major cited blocks (`74.50 mm²`), LPDDR5X-9600 (`76.8 GB/s`) sits strictly below D9500 LPDDR5X-10667 (`85.336 GB/s`), CMOS clock-power ratio cancels `α, C, V`, and Roofline `min(P, ai·B)` obeys universal peak/memory bounds & bandwidth monotonicity.                                                                            | `kernel-checked` (constructive, 0 Choice)    | `cd lean && lake build Solution && lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean` (`target_thm1_hardware_and_roofline`)             | Any kernel failure in `lean`, `leanchecker`, `lean4lean`, `nanoda`, `con-leche`, or `con-ron`, or a primary Xiaomi/MediaTek datasheet contradicting Kurnal's die measurements. |
| **C03**  | EUV Rayleigh resolution decreases strictly with NA (`5/3` gain at `0.55` vs `0.33 NA`), DOF shrinks quadratically (`25/9` penalty), and 13.5 nm EUV photons carry `1933/135 > 14×` more energy per photon than 193.3 nm ArF DUV photons.                                                                                                                                                                                        | `kernel-checked` + `oracle-60digit`          | `target_thm2_euv_rayleigh_and_dof` + `python reference/physics_oracle.py`                                             | Any discrepancy `> 1e-12` against 60-digit CODATA 2018 arithmetic or failure of `target_thm2_euv_rayleigh_and_dof`.                                                            |
| **C04**  | Exact $2\times 2$ complex transfer matrix for a 40-bilayer Mo/Si EUV Bragg mirror (`d = 6.92 nm`, `γ = 0.4`, CXRO constants) yields `R(13.5 nm) ≈ 74.32%` and 11-mirror transmission `R^{11} ≈ 3.82%`, matching an independent 60-digit Python `Decimal` matrix solver to relative error `< 2.2e-14`; algebraically, $\det(AB) = \det(A)\det(B)$ and unimodular layers preserve $\det = 1$ over $\mathbb{Z}[i]$.                | `kernel-checked` + `oracle-60digit`          | `target_thm9_bragg_parseval_and_shards` + `python reference/physics_oracle.py`                                        | Relative discrepancy `> 1e-11` between JS `braggReflectivityAt` and 60-digit `bragg_reflectivity_decimal`, or failure of `mat2c_det_mul`.                                      |
| **C05**  | Exact Crank–Nicolson Cayley evolution `(1 + ih)ψ₁ = (1 - ih)ψ₀` preserves squared norm `normSq(ψ₁) = normSq(ψ₀)` identically over $\mathbb{Z}[i]$; the browser 1D TDSE solver conserves discrete norm to `< 1e-8`; relativistic Dirac dispersion satisfies `-E < p < E` for `m > 0`; FinFET $\lambda^2$ is permittivity-scale invariant.                                                                                        | `kernel-checked` + `numerical_approximation` | `target_thm3_dirac_finfet_and_crank_nicolson` + `tests/v2-engines.test.mjs`                                           | Any norm drift `≥ 1e-8` over 120 TDSE steps or failure of `crank_nicolson_exact_unitarity` / `dirac_subluminal_for_positive_mass`.                                             |
| **C06**  | Explicit 2D 5-point FDTD heat stencil obeys the Discrete Minimum/Maximum Principle (`min5 ≤ T_next ≤ max5`) whenever `2rx + 2ry ≤ D` (zero overshoot/undershoot); Xiaomi 3D IceLoop (`h_vc > h_novc`) strictly lowers peak temperature; closed-loop DVFS sub-stepping (`<= 0.5 s`) eliminates 30 s bang-bang aliasing across 1,200 s.                                                                                           | `kernel-checked` + `numerical_approximation` | `target_thm4_fdtd_cfl_maximum_principle` + `tests/properties-and-regressions.test.mjs`                                | Any post-warmup step jump `≥ 5 °C` between adjacent 30 s samples in `simulateSustainedThrottle`, or `withVc.peakC ≥ noVc.peakC`.                                               |

## FILE: LIMITATIONS.md

# Limitations & Literal-vs-Metaphor Boundary (`LIMITATIONS.md`)

This document states explicitly what `xiaomi-17t-pro-lab` (v3.1.0) **does not prove, measure, or claim** (Build Standard v1.2.0 B41 & Playbook v1.3).

## 1. Hard Scientific & Hardware Boundaries

1. **Zero Open Mega-Atlas Problems Retired (`0 / 1,900`):** This repository does NOT solve any open conjecture or frontier engineering challenge in `0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas` (see [docs/mega-atlas-cross-reference.md](docs/mega-atlas-cross-reference.md)).
2. **No Browser Execution on MediaTek NPU 990:** Web browsers expose no WebNN/NeuroPilot kernel path to the Dimensity 9500 NPU 990. TinyStories-8M inference (`#/work/llm`) and quantization benchmarks (`#/npu`) run on the visitor's JavaScript CPU thread (or optional WebGL2 shader).
3. **Seven Unpublished Hardware Leaves Remain `UNKNOWN` (`null`):** Nominal battery watt-hours, reverse-wireless wattage, rear glass composition, device UFS lane count (2 vs. 4), official Mali-G1 Ultra MC12 clock frequency, PhoneArena matching iPhone benchmark, and Galaxy street pricing remain explicitly `null` in `data/specs.json`. TSMC N3P fin height, gate length, and high-$k$ dielectric stack thicknesses are proprietary and not claimed.
4. **Formal Proof vs. IEEE-754 Floating-Point Gap:** Pure Lean 4.35.0 (`lean/XiaomiLabProofs/`) certifies exact algebraic, combinatorial, stability, and inequality theorems over `Nat`, `Int`, and `ℤ[i]`. It does NOT formally verify JavaScript/V8 IEEE-754 `Float64` rounding propagation (which is instead checked empirically to `< 2.2e-14` relative error by the independent 60-digit Python oracle `reference/physics_oracle.py`).
5. **Continuum & Paraxial Physical Approximations:**
   - The 2D FDTD thermal solver (`src/sim/thermal-fdtd.js`) models macroscopic mm-scale Fourier diffusion with lumped convective conductance; it does NOT model nanoscale ballistic phonon transport (`CM-039`) or atomic interfacial Kapitza resistance (`CM-064`), and block wattage splits are modeled parameters (`computed`), not leaked silicon telemetry.
   - The 2D EUV lithography engine (`src/sim/litho-2d.js`) uses scalar thin-mask Kirchhoff Fourier optics, not full 3D Maxwell thick-mask absorber FDTD.
6. **Software WebGL on CI Runners:** GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runners execute Playwright via SwiftShader CPU WebGL; physical Mali-G1 Ultra MC12 rendering requires on-device inspection.
7. **Not Externally Peer Reviewed:** The accompanying AMS-LaTeX white paper (`dist/Donahue_2026_Xiaomi_17T_Pro_Lab.pdf`) is an independent research preprint and has not undergone external journal peer review.

## 2. Literal vs. Metaphor Table

| Term / Feature in Lab                                 | Literal Reality                                                                                                                                               | What It Is NOT                                                                                                                                                       |
| :---------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **"Neuralese" LLM Workbench (`#/work/llm`)**          | Real 8.3M-parameter FP16 GPT-Neo (`TinyStories-8M`) forward pass with live attention/MLP gain scaling and layer ablation hooks on JS CPU.                     | Not a frontier LLM, not running on NPU 990, and not human-level reasoning.                                                                                           |
| **"Glitchling / Asmodensius" A-Life (`#/work/life`)** | Deterministic 272-neuron rate-coded foraging network in a fixed 16-site 2D arena (`vendor/glitchling/sim.js`) with toggleable sensory/motor flaws.            | Not sentient, not conscious, not open-ended biological evolution; full TypeScript CQM organisms stay in their separate non-commercial repo (`docs/licenses/cqm.md`). |
| **"Tsotchke" Quantum Lab (`#/work/sci`)**             | Exact 1–3 qubit complex statevector simulator computing Born probabilities, Bloch vectors, entanglement entropy, CHSH, Mermin-3, and Peres–Mermin parity.     | Not a quantum computer, not large-scale tensor-network hardware, and not solving `QM-007`/`QM-011`.                                                                  |
| **"GigaChad Mobile Cortex" (`#/work/browser`)**       | Interactive 60 Hz browser swarm kinematics and client-side micro-benchmark demonstration.                                                                     | Not a standalone browser engine replacement or kernel driver.                                                                                                        |
| **"3D IceLoop VC" Thermal PDE (`#/thermal`)**         | 2D finite-difference heat PDE on the cited `10.88×12.92 mm` Kurnal floorplan comparing higher vs. lower modeled lateral diffusivity & convective conductance. | Not a calibrated 3D finite-element CFD two-phase vapor-chamber simulation from Xiaomi thermal CAD.                                                                   |

## FILE: REPLICATION.md

# Replication Protocol (`REPLICATION.md`)

Complete instructions to independently reproduce every computational result, formal Lean 4.35.0 proof, 60-digit oracle verification, statistical test, browser E2E test, and AMS-LaTeX white paper from a clean clone (Build Standard v1.2.0 B43 & B44).

## 1. Prerequisites

- **Node.js:** `>= 22.0.0` (`.nvmrc` pinned to `22`)
- **Python:** `>= 3.12` (standard library only for `physics_oracle.py`, `check_readme_axioms.py`, `package_dist.py`; optional `uv` / `matplotlib` + `numpy` only if regenerating PDF figures)
- **Lean 4:** `leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0` via `elan` (`lean/lean-toolchain`)
- **LaTeX:** `tectonic` (`>= 0.15`) for zero-warning PDF & standalone arXiv compilation
- **Optional:** `just` task runner (every command below can also be run directly without `just`)

## 2. Clean-Clone End-to-End Replication Commands

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/xiaomi-17t-pro-lab.git
cd xiaomi-17t-pro-lab
npm ci

# 1. Schema validation, 50 unit/property/metamorphic/golden/EIO tests, and 8/8 mutation testing (~15 s)
npm run validate
npm test
node scripts/mutate.mjs

# 2. Runnable examples (~1 s)
node examples/01_euv_and_bragg.mjs
node examples/02_thermal_fdtd_iceloop.mjs
node examples/03_quantum_contextuality.mjs

# 3. Independent 60-digit Python Decimal/Fraction differential oracle + SHA-256 manifests (~2 s)
python reference/physics_oracle.py --check-checksums

# 4. Deterministic TinyStories-8M 9-shard eval, perf benchmarks, and 20-seed statistical eval (~25 s)
node evals/run_tinystories_eval.mjs
node scripts/bench.mjs
node scripts/stats_eval.mjs

# 5. Pure Lean 4.35.0 formal build, 59-declaration axiom audit, and leanchecker (~15–120 s)
cd lean
lake build XiaomiLabProofs Challenge Solution
lake env lean VerifyAxioms.lean
lake env leanchecker --fresh XiaomiLabProofs
lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution
# On Linux with bubblewrap (automated in GitHub Actions CI):
# lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
cd ..
python scripts/check_readme_axioms.py

# 6. Zero-warning AMS-LaTeX white paper & clean-room arXiv tarball check (~10 s)
python scripts/package_dist.py

# 7. Playwright 19-route browser smoke & strict CSP check (~45 s)
npx playwright install chromium
npm run test:smoke
```

## 3. Expected Tolerances & Pass Criteria

- **60-digit Oracle (`reference/physics_oracle.py`):** 54/54 checks pass, max relative error `< 1e-11` (observed `2.159e-14`).
- **Mutation Testing (`scripts/mutate.mjs`):** 8/8 mutants killed (`100.0%`).
- **Statistical Eval (`scripts/stats_eval.mjs`):** 4/4 hypotheses significant (`p_holm < 0.05`, observed `≤ 0.0008`).
- **TinyStories Eval (`evals/run_tinystories_eval.mjs`):** Reassembled SHA-256 equals `9999a42aa4cb668c19760c02448ab97b0458c89871013fa8d0c5cae2a569c28f`; greedy tokens for `"Once upon a time"` equal `[11, 612, 373, 257, 1310, 2576, 3706, 20037]`.
- **Lean 4.35.0:** 75/75 constructive audited declarations strictly within `[propext, Quot.sound]` (**0 `Classical.choice`**, 28 zero-axiom); 0 `sorry` outside `Challenge.lean`; live negative kernel & comparator rejection PASS.
- **Citations & Integrity:** `python scripts/check_repo_integrity.py` (0 broken/case-mismatch links, 0 CRLF, 0 malformed Markdown tables, strict CSP+favicon) & `python scripts/check_citations.py` (12/12 live Crossref/arXiv DOIs, 0 retractions).
- **LaTeX (`scripts/package_dist.py`):** 0 overfull/underfull hboxes, 0 undefined refs/citations, standalone arXiv tarball compiles cleanly (`plainurl` clickable DOIs).

## FILE: docs/mega-atlas-cross-reference.md

# Unsolved Problems Mega-Atlas Cross-Reference

> **Direct Honest Verdict:** **`xiaomi-17t-pro-lab` retires `0 / 1,900` grand open problems** in [`0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`](https://github.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas) (`MegaAtlas_Unsolved_Problems_V2.json.gz`, 1,900 problems audited 2026-11-25).

## 1. Epistemic Accounting — What This Repository Does vs. Does Not Solve

`xiaomi-17t-pro-lab` is a **forensic hardware-provenance workbench, real-time multi-scale silicon-to-quantum simulator, 60-digit differential oracle, and six-kernel Lean 4.35.0 invariant verification suite** anchored to the Xiaomi 17T Pro (MediaTek Dimensity 9500 / MT6993Z, TSMC N3P).

- **It DOES** certify 59 exact algebraic, numerical-stability, and quantum-contextuality declarations in Lean 4.35.0 (`XiaomiLabProofs` + `Solution.lean`) across 6 independent kernels, differentially verify 54 floating-point physics quantities against an independent 60-digit `Decimal`/`Fraction` oracle, kill 8/8 planted semantic mutants, and preserve strict hardware provenance (`cited` vs `computed` vs `measured` vs `UNKNOWN`).
- **It DOES NOT** resolve any open conjecture or frontier engineering problem in `unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`. Every equation simulated (Rayleigh/Abbe, Mo/Si Bragg transfer matrix, WKB tunneling, Dirac dispersion, Varshni intrinsic silicon, FinFET scale length, Fourier 2D FDTD, Roofline, Crank–Nicolson TDSE, Bell-CHSH, Mermin-3 GHZ, Peres–Mermin 3×3) is established textbook physics or finite algebraic verification of known bounds.

## 2. Exact Mapping to Adjacent Mega-Atlas Open Problems (13 IDs)

The table below maps each module of `xiaomi-17t-pro-lab` to the exact open Mega-Atlas problems it illustrates or bounds, stating clearly why the parent problem remains **STILL OPEN**:

| Mega-Atlas ID           | Superdomain                                 | Status (2026)                    | Problem Name                                                                                          | Bounded Connection in `xiaomi-17t-pro-lab`                                                                                                                                             | Why Parent Problem Remains OPEN                                                                                                                 |
| :---------------------- | :------------------------------------------ | :------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`HW-001`**            | Electronics, Photonics & Computing Hardware | Experimental Tension / Crisis    | Post-Moore Computing Paradigm Beyond Atomic-Scale Silicon CMOS Scaling Limits                         | FinFET natural length $\lambda$ (`src/sim/finfet.js`), WKB gate leakage (`src/sim/dirac-tunnel.js`), Lean `finfet_thinner_body_reduces_lambda_sq`.                                     | Illustrates N3P CMOS limits; does not invent or fabricate a post-silicon replacement paradigm.                                                  |
| **`HW-005`**            | Electronics, Photonics & Computing Hardware | Experimental Tension / Crisis    | Extreme Thermal Management & Heat Dissipation (>1–2 kW/cm²) in 3D Stacked Heterogeneous ICs           | 2D FDTD die thermal PDE + Xiaomi 3D IceLoop VC model (`src/sim/thermal-fdtd.js`) & Lean CFL discrete max principle (`ThermalFdtd.lean`).                                               | Models planar smartphone SoC (~10 W / 1.4 cm²); does not solve >1 kW/cm² interior 3D-stacked cooling.                                           |
| **`HW-012`**            | Electronics, Photonics & Computing Hardware | Completely Open                  | Breaking the Subthreshold Swing 'Boltzmann Tyranny' (<60 mV/dec at 300 K)                             | Subthreshold leakage runaway $n_i(T)$ (`src/sim/dirac-tunnel.js`) and electrostatics (`src/sim/finfet.js`).                                                                            | Demonstrates the classical 300 K thermal leakage problem; does not break 60 mV/dec.                                                             |
| **`HW-015`**            | Electronics, Photonics & Computing Hardware | Active Breakthroughs / Frontier  | Sub-Nanometer Lithography Economics, Stochastic Shot-Noise Defects & Beyond-High-NA EUV Patterning    | 13.5 nm EUV 91.84 eV photon energy, 40-bilayer Mo/Si Bragg mirror, 2D Fourier OPC (`litho-2d.js`), sub-pixel Poisson shot-noise LER (`litho-advanced.js`), Lean `EuvLithography.lean`. | Quantifies the >14× EUV photon deficit and High-NA 25/9 DOF penalty; does not eliminate stochastic resist defects or surpass High-NA economics. |
| **`HW-017`**            | Electronics, Photonics & Computing Hardware | Experimental Tension / Crisis    | Breaking the Von Neumann Memory Wall via 3D High-Bandwidth Compute-in-Memory & Hybrid Bonding         | LPDDR5X-9600 (76.8 GB/s) & UFS 4.1 Roofline model (`src/sim/memory-model.js`), live browser pointer-chase/STREAM, Lean `HardwareFloorplan.lean`.                                       | Quantifies the mobile LLM decode memory wall; does not build 3D hybrid-bonded CIM silicon.                                                      |
| **`AI-042`**            | AI, ML & Foundation Models                  | Active Breakthroughs / Frontier  | Extreme Low-Bit Quantization (Sub-1-Bit / Ternary) & Sparse Activation Without Capability Degradation | BitNet 1.58-bit ($\log_2 3$ bits/wt) vs symmetric INT8 matmul error lab (`src/sim/quant.js`) & NPU 990 documentation.                                                                  | Demonstrates quantization error trade-offs on synthetic matrices; does not train a frontier lossless ternary model.                             |
| **`AI-045`**            | AI, ML & Foundation Models                  | Active Breakthroughs / Frontier  | Open-Ended Artificial Life, Automated Environment Generation & Unbounded Novelty Creation             | Vendored 272-neuron Glitchling embodied foraging simulator (`src/labs/work.js`, `vendor/glitchling/sim.js`).                                                                           | Fixed 16-site foraging arena; non-sentient and bounded, not open-ended evolution.                                                               |
| **`QM-007`**            | Quantum Mechanics, QFT & Particle Physics   | Completely Open                  | Physical Principle Selecting Quantum Correlations (Why the Tsirelson Bound $2\sqrt{2}$?)              | Exact Bell-CHSH statevector simulator (`src/sim/quantum-lab.js`) & Lean `chsh_classical_bound` (`-2 <= S <= 2` vs `S_Q^2 = 8`).                                                        | Certifies the known algebraic Tsirelson gap; does not derive Tsirelson's bound from a new physical axiom.                                       |
| **`QM-011`**            | Quantum Mechanics, QFT & Particle Physics   | Partially Solved / Special Cases | Quantum Contextuality, Ontological Models & Psi-Ontic vs. Psi-Epistemic Realism                       | Exact Peres–Mermin 3×3 magic square (`pmSatisfiedCount <= 5` vs 6/6) & Mermin-3 GHZ (`<= 2` vs `4`) in `QuantumContextuality.lean`.                                                    | Re-certifies canonical 2- and 3-qubit proofs; overarching ontological question remains OPEN.                                                    |
| **`QM-015`**            | Quantum Mechanics, QFT & Particle Physics   | Active Breakthroughs / Frontier  | Tunneling Time Problem (Larmor, Büttiker–Landauer & Attosecond Clock Controversy)                     | Unitary Crank–Nicolson TDSE wave-packet barrier scattering (`src/sim/tdse.js`) & Lean Cayley unitarity (`QuantumTransport.lean`).                                                      | Evolves standard 1D Schrödinger wave packets; does not resolve relativistic/experimental tunneling-time definitions.                            |
| **`CM-039`**            | Condensed Matter & Quantum Materials        | Active Breakthroughs / Frontier  | Non-Fourier Ballistic-Diffusive Phonon Transport & Phonon Hydrodynamics in Nanostructures             | Explicit limitation boundary of our continuum Fourier heat PDE (`src/sim/thermal-fdtd.js`).                                                                                            | Our FDTD solver assumes continuum Fourier diffusion at mm scale and explicitly does NOT model nanoscale ballistic phonons.                      |
| **`CM-064`**            | Condensed Matter & Quantum Materials        | Active Breakthroughs / Frontier  | Interfacial Thermal Resistance (Kapitza Conductance) & Atomic-Scale Heat Dissipation in 3D Chips      | Lumped effective conductance `hConv` in `thermal-fdtd.js` (clearly labeled `computed`, not microscopic Kapitza simulation).                                                            | Does not compute ab-initio atomic-interface Kapitza resistance.                                                                                 |
| **`CS-058` / `HW-032`** | CS / Hardware Verification                  | Active Breakthroughs / Frontier  | Scalable End-to-End Formal Verification of Cyber-Physical Software & Zero-Errata Silicon Tape-Out     | 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 formal core (`XiaomiLabProofs`) + 60-digit differential oracle + mutation testing.                                                                                | Verifies algebraic models of lab physics, not industrial RTL tape-out or full JS/V8 compilation.                                                |

## 3. Distinction From Sibling Research Repositories in `0thernes-research-archive`

For completeness when checking the broader `0thernes` portfolio against `unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`, **other dedicated research repositories** in `0thernes-research-archive` DO resolve explicitly scoped sub-conjectures from the literature linked to parent Mega-Atlas IDs (while still honestly marking all overarching parent Mega-Atlas problems as `STILL OPEN`):

- `0TH-2026-004` (`kochen-specker-extremal-lab`, parent `QM-011`): certified exact minimal KS sizes in restricted coordinate pools (31 in 3D integer, 18 in 4D `{0, ±1}^4`).
- `0TH-2026-009` (`pauli-contextuality-lab`, parent `QM-011`): proved Jonah's Conjecture E across all 9 vertex cases for all $N \ge 4$ and disjoint Mermin copy formulas.
- `0TH-2026-010` (`catalytic-register-frontiers`, parent `CS-005`): resolved two open questions of Vinciguerra (arXiv:2609.18692) on passive catalytic registers.
- `0TH-2026-012` (`coded-pir-mlwe-complexity-lab`, parents `CS-053`, `CS-026`): resolved Schur-product syzygy rank and refuted Luo (arXiv:2604.15858).

**`xiaomi-17t-pro-lab` (`0TH-BUILD-012`) makes NO such open-problem retirement claim.** Its contribution is rigorous forensic hardware documentation, real-time multi-scale computational simulation, 60-digit differential verification, and constructive six-kernel Lean 4.35.0 certification (75 audited declarations, zero `Classical.choice`) of its own mathematical invariants.

# Statement-Fidelity Audit (`docs/statement-fidelity.md`)

Playbook v1.3 mandatory statement-fidelity audit mapping every white-paper theorem (`paper/main.tex`, v3.1.0) 1-to-1 against its isolated `lean/Challenge.lean` comparator signature, hypotheses, constructive axiom profile (**0 `Classical.choice` across all 75 audited declarations**), and honest scope boundary.

| Paper Result                                                                              | Isolated `Challenge.lean` Target              | Hypotheses in Lean                                                         | Axioms Used           | Matches Textbook / Paper Literal Statement?                                           | Honest Scope / Gap Note                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Theorem 1** (Hardware Die Packing, LPDDR5X Gap, CMOS Ratio & Universal Roofline)        | `target_thm1_hardware_and_roofline`           | `0 ≤ ai`, `bw1 ≤ bw2` over `Int`/`Nat`                                     | `propext, Quot.sound` | **Yes (exact cleared-denominator integer form)**                                      | Die dimensions (`10.88×12.92 mm`), block areas, and LPDDR5X rates are anchored to `data/specs.json` cited values; CMOS $\alpha, C, V$ remain symbolic.                                                   |
| **Theorem 2** (EUV Rayleigh Monotonicity, High-NA 25/9 DOF Penalty & >14× Photon Deficit) | `target_thm2_euv_rayleigh_and_dof`            | `0 < k1, k2, lam, na1`, `na1 < na2` over `Int`/`Nat`                       | `propext, Quot.sound` | **Yes (exact cleared-denominator rational inequality)**                               | Models ideal paraxial scalar imaging; does not formalize full 3D rigorous coupled-wave EUV mask absorber diffraction.                                                                                    |
| **Theorem 3** (Crank–Nicolson Cayley Unitarity, Dirac Subluminality & FinFET Invariance)  | `target_thm3_dirac_finfet_and_crank_nicolson` | `CInt.mul ⟨1, h⟩ psiNext = CInt.mul ⟨1, -h⟩ psiPrev`, `0 ≤ E`, `0 < m`     | `propext, Quot.sound` | **Yes (exact scalar-eigenmode Cayley unitarity over $\mathbb{Z}[i]$)**                | Certifies the exact algebraic mechanism preserving `\|ψ\|²` on every Hermitian eigenmode; browser IEEE-754 Thomas tridiagonal rounding is checked separately to `< 1e-8` in `tests/v2-engines.test.mjs`. |
| **Theorem 4** (2D FDTD CFL Discrete Minimum/Maximum Principle & IceLoop Cooling)          | `target_thm4_fdtd_cfl_maximum_principle`      | `0 ≤ rx`, `0 ≤ ry`, `2*rx + 2*ry ≤ D`, `Tamb < T`, `0 < dt`, `hNoVc < hVc` | `propext, Quot.sound` | **Yes (exact interior 5-point explicit stencil)**                                     | Certifies the pure diffusion stencil & linear convective sink; exponential subthreshold leakage $q_{\text{leak}}(T)$ is nonlinear and clamped at 125 °C in `src/sim/thermal-fdtd.js`.                    |

| **Theorem 7** (Single-Qubit Bloch Sphere Identity & Mixed-State Purity Bounds)            | `target_thm7_bloch_purity_bounds`             | Pure `(a, b) : CInt × CInt`; mixed `0 ≤ p, q`                              | `propext, Quot.sound` | **Yes (exact over $\mathbb{Z}[i]$ and $\mathbb{Z}\_{\ge 0}$)**                        | Certifies exact algebraic sphere norm $r = 1$ and $1/2 \le \operatorname{Tr}(\rho^2) \le 1$ in cleared-denominator form.                                                                                 |

# AI Model Provenance, Evaluation, and Resource Budget (`docs/ai.md`)

Build Standard v1.2.0 **A40** and **B34** documentation for the embedded neural language model shipped with `xiaomi-17t-pro-lab`.

## 1. Pinned Model Artifact

- **Model:** `roneneldan/TinyStories-8M` (8.3M-parameter GPT-Neo: 8 layers, 16 heads, `d = 256`, alternating global / 256-token local attention, `gelu_new`, vocab 50,257), converted from upstream F32 to F16 via `tools/pack-tinystories.mjs`.
- **Storage & Pinning:** Deterministically split into 9 byte-exact shards under `vendor/tinystories/shards/model.f16.safetensors.part00..part08` (each `≤ 4,500,000` bytes < 5 MiB A24 limit).
- **Cryptographic Hash:** Full reassembled checkpoint (`39,417,097` bytes) SHA-256 = `9999a42aa4cb668c19760c02448ab97b0458c89871013fa8d0c5cae2a569c28f` (`vendor/tinystories/shards.json` and `vendor/tinystories/SHA256.txt`), verified in-browser via WebCrypto `crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", ...)` and in Node tests.
- **Execution Boundary:** Runs strictly client-side on the visitor's JavaScript CPU thread (`src/workloads/gpt-neo.js`). **Never** calls external APIs, **never** sends prompts over the network, and **never** claims execution on MediaTek NPU 990.

## 2. Deterministic Evaluation Suite (`evals/run_tinystories_eval.mjs`)

Run via `node evals/run_tinystories_eval.mjs` (or `just evals`):

- Verifies every shard's byte length and SHA-256 plus reassembled full-file SHA-256;
- Evaluates 5 canonical narrative prompts (8 greedy tokens each), pinning bit-exact token IDs for `"Once upon a time"` → `[11, 612, 373, 257, 1310, 2576, 3706, 20037]` (`", there was a little girl named Lily"`);
- Checks exact full-vocabulary (50,257-token) Shannon entropy finiteness (`0 < H < 16` bits);
- Verifies Neuralese intervention sensitivity: ablating layer `h.4` shifts next-token entropy by `ΔH = 0.519` bits (`> 0.05` bit threshold).
- Writes structured JSON telemetry to `results/tinystories-eval.json`.

## 3. Resource, Network, and Latency Budget

- **Zero Financial / API Cost Budget:** `\$0.00` per invocation (100% static local/browser inference, zero third-party inference API keys or metered calls).
- **Network Transfer Budget (First Load on `#/work/llm` only):** `39.4 MB` weights (9 parallel HTTP/2 shards, lazy-loaded ONLY when the user presses _Stream Generate_ — `0 B` transferred on all other 18 routes) + `1.25 MB` tokenizer (`vocab.json` + `merges.txt`).
- **RAM Expansion Budget:** `~85 MB` peak browser heap when unpacking F16 → Float32Array weights in `src/workloads/safetensors.js` (cached once per tab session).
- **Compute Latency Budget:** Target `≤ 15 s` cold parse + `≤ 500 ms/token` greedy CPU decode on desktop Node 22 (measured in `results/tinystories-eval.json`).

# Threat Model (`docs/threat-model.md`)

STRIDE threat analysis for `xiaomi-17t-pro-lab` (Build Standard v1.2.0 **B36**), mapped directly to automated verification tests and CI checks.

## 1. System Boundary & Trust Assumptions

- **Client-Side Static Site (GitHub Pages):** Pure ES modules executed in the user's browser sandbox. Zero authentication, zero cookies, zero server-side state, zero external CDN or telemetry requests.
- **Local Development Server (`tools/serve.mjs`):** Loopback-only (`127.0.0.1`) static file server intended for local development and Playwright CI verification, never exposed to untrusted public networks.

## 2. STRIDE Matrix & Verified Mitigations

| Category                   | Concrete Threat                                                                                                          | Mitigation in Code                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Automated Verification Test                                                                                 |
| :------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Spoofing**               | Supply-chain tampering of TinyStories-8M weights or vendored assets                                                      | Deterministic 9-shard manifest (`shards.json`) + WebCrypto `SHA-256` verification in `fetchShardedSafetensors` + `data/MANIFEST.sha256` + `CHECKSUMS.sha256` + SLSA attestation (`release.yml`)                          | `tests/rebuild.test.mjs`, `evals/run_tinystories_eval.mjs`, `reference/physics_oracle.py --check-checksums` |
| **Tampering**              | Script/style injection (XSS) via inline DOM styles or `new Function`                                                     | Strict CSP in both `index.html` and `tools/serve.mjs`: `default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'sha256-...' ; style-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'none'` (zero `unsafe-inline`, zero `eval`/`new Function`) | `tests/v22.test.mjs`, `tests/e2e/smoke.spec.js` (0 console CSP errors across 19 routes)                     |
| **Tampering**              | Directory traversal or prefix-sibling escape (`/repo` → `/repo-secret`) on local dev server                              | `resolveSafe` in `tools/serve.mjs` rejects null bytes, invalid URI encodings, `..`, and absolute `path.relative` escapes; HTTP `403`                                                                                     | `tests/server.test.mjs`                                                                                     |
| **Repudiation**            | Unaudited claims, silent edits, or unverifiable proof scripts                                                            | Linear git history, append-only `docs/run-log.md`, `ERRATA.md`, 6-kernel `lake comparator --paranoid`, `actions/attest-build-provenance@v2`                                                                              | `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/release.yml`                                                 |
| **Information Disclosure** | Accidental commit of API keys/tokens or MIME sniffing on served files                                                    | `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, report-only `gitleaks` + `osv-scanner` in CI, `Audit-Repo.ps1` secret pattern check                                                                   | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`report-only-static`), `tests/properties-and-regressions.test.mjs`              |
| **Denial of Service**      | Uncaught `fs.createReadStream` disk `EIO` crashing server, or `NaN`/huge allocations (`createState(30)`) hanging browser | Stream `error` handler in `tools/serve.mjs` returns clean `500` without crashing; finite/positive domain guards (`1 ≤ nQubits ≤ 12`, `nx, ny ≥ 4`, `parsePort`)                                                          | `tests/properties-and-regressions.test.mjs` (`B06` negative tests & `B21` EIO injection)                    |
| **Elevation of Privilege** | Unauthorized HTTP write methods or cross-origin Spectre timing leakage                                                   | `tools/serve.mjs` enforces `405 Method Not Allowed` outside `GET`/`HEAD`, binds `127.0.0.1` only, and sends `COOP: same-origin` / `COEP: require-corp`                                                                   | `tests/properties-and-regressions.test.mjs` (`B09`)                                                         |

# Performance Benchmarks & Latency Budgets (`docs/benchmarks.md`)

Build Standard v1.2.0 **B26**, **B27**, and **A37** reproducible performance tracking for `xiaomi-17t-pro-lab` (v3.1.0).

## 1. Benchmark Methodology

- Harness: `node scripts/bench.mjs` (`results/perf-benchmarks.json`).
- Each solver executes a cold warmup pass followed by 15–40 timed iterations via `performance.now()`.
- Reported statistics: **median**, **IQR (`p75 - p25`)**, **p95**, and **hard frame-budget target** (aligned to 60–144 Hz interactive frame budgets).

| :--------------------------------- | ---------: | ----------: | -------: | -------: | ---------------: | :------- |

| `litho_2d_64x64_annular_opc`       |         20 |       1.916 |    0.727 |    3.808 |             40.0 | **PASS** |
| `stochastic_resist_48x256`         |         20 |       1.658 |    1.766 |    3.151 |             20.0 | **PASS** |
| `tdse_crank_nicolson_50steps_n240` |         30 |       0.254 |    0.756 |    6.806 |             15.0 | **PASS** |

## 3. Honest Caveats (B27)

- Small-iteration JIT warm-up and OS scheduling jitter explain p95 tails (`~3–15 ms`); CI tracks these report-only rather than gating merges.
- Browser render times depend heavily on GPU hardware (real Mali-G1 Ultra MC12 vs. SwiftShader software WebGL in CI).
- TinyStories-8M cold load (`~10 s` to parse 39.4 MB FP16 → Float32 on Node CPU) is tracked separately in `docs/ai.md` and `results/tinystories-eval.json`.

# Pre-Registration of Computational Hypotheses (`docs/preregistration.md`)

Build Standard v1.2.0 **B32** pre-registration specification for `scripts/stats_eval.mjs` (`results/stats-eval.json`).

## 1. Study Design

- **Seeds:** Fixed deterministic 20-seed panel (`seed_i = 1000 + 97 * i`, `i = 0..19`) across independent control and treatment arms.
- **Inference Procedure:** Two-sided Monte Carlo permutation test (`10,000` resamples, seeded PRNG `mulberry32(20261125)`), `10,000`-resample nonparametric 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for mean difference, parametric effect size (Cohen's $d$), nonparametric effect size (Cliff's $\delta$), and family-wise error rate control via Holm–Bonferroni (`α = 0.05`).

## 2. Pre-Registered Hypotheses (H1–H4)

1. **H1 (`H1_dose_ler`):** At 0.33 NA, 44 nm pitch, increasing EUV exposure dose from `15 mJ/cm²` to `60 mJ/cm²` strictly reduces sub-pixel 3σ stochastic resist LER ($\Delta = \text{LER}_{15} - \text{LER}_{60} > 0$).
2. **H2 (`H2_na_ler`):** At 30 nm pitch (`conventional`, `σ = 0.55`, `35 mJ/cm²`), `0.55` High-NA yields strictly lower sub-pixel 3σ LER than `0.33` NA ($\Delta = \text{LER}_{0.33} - \text{LER}_{0.55} > 0$).
3. **H3 (`H3_chsh_violation`):** Sampled Bell $|\Phi^+\rangle$ CHSH statistic (`2,000` shots, $\theta = 22.5^\circ$) strictly exceeds the classical local-hidden-variable control ($\theta = 0^\circ$, $S = 2.0$).
4. **H4 (`H4_mermin3_violation`):** Sampled 3-qubit GHZ Mermin-3 statistic (`2,000` shots, $\phi = 0^\circ$) strictly exceeds the classical non-contextual control ($\phi = 60^\circ$, $M = 2.0$).

## 3. Deviation & Defect Disclosure

During initial execution on v2.2 code, **H1** inverted sign (`Δ = -7.87 nm`) and **H2** collapsed (`Δ = 0.00 nm`), exposing a real edge-detector pinhole bias in `src/sim/litho-advanced.js` (`ERRATA.md` E-003) and an uninformative dipole harmonic regime at 28 nm pitch. After fixing the sub-pixel metrology window and specifying H1/H2 cleanly above, all 4 hypotheses achieved $p_{\text{Holm}} \le 0.0008$ (logged transparently in `results/stats-eval.json` and white paper Section 5.2).

# Frequently Asked Questions (`docs/faq.md`)

### 1. Does `xiaomi-17t-pro-lab` solve any open problem in `unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`?

**No (`0 / 1,900` retired).** This workbench implements established multi-scale physics and certifies finite/algebraic invariants of those models in Lean 4.35.0. See [docs/mega-atlas-cross-reference.md](mega-atlas-cross-reference.md) for the exact 13 adjacent open IDs and why each parent problem remains open.

### 2. Does the in-browser TinyStories-8M LLM or BitNet lab run on the Dimensity 9500 NPU 990?

**No.** Standard web browsers do not expose MediaTek NeuroPilot / NPU 990 execution APIs. Every browser workload executes on the visitor's CPU JavaScript thread (or optional WebGL2 shader) and labels that boundary explicitly.

### 3. Why is the Xiaomi 17T Pro's battery watt-hour rating shown as `UNKNOWN`?

Xiaomi publishes `7000 mAh` typical capacity and a `4.58 V` high-voltage cell rating, not nominal discharge voltage or Wh. Multiplying `7000 mAh × 4.58 V` would fabricate an inflated Wh figure, so `batteryWh` remains `null` (`UNKNOWN`).

### 4. Why is TinyStories-8M split into 9 shards under `vendor/tinystories/shards/`?

Build Standard v1.2.0 (`A24`) caps tracked repository files at 5 MiB (`5,242,880` bytes). Splitting the `39,417,097`-byte FP16 safetensors file into nine byte-exact `≤ 4.5 MB` shards keeps GitHub Pages 100% self-hosted and offline-capable while verifying exact bit-for-bit SHA-256 (`9999a42a...`) in both browsers (WebCrypto) and Node tests.

### 5. What does the Lean 4.35.0 formal core actually prove — and what does it NOT prove?

`lean/XiaomiLabProofs/` proves 59 exact algebraic, combinatorial, CFL stability, Cayley unitarity, and quantum contextuality declarations over `Nat`, `Int`, and `ℤ[i]` across 6 independent kernels with zero Mathlib and zero custom axioms. It does **not** formally verify V8 IEEE-754 floating-point rounding (which is checked differentially to `< 2.2e-14` by `reference/physics_oracle.py`).

### 6. Why are there no Pull Requests or git hooks?

Build Standard v1.2.0 Hard Rules **R1–R4** mandate a direct-to-`main` linear solo-researcher workflow with zero blocking commit hooks, zero PR templates, and report-only linters/SAST in CI.

### 7. Is the white paper peer reviewed?

**No.** `dist/Donahue_2026_Xiaomi_17T_Pro_Lab.pdf` is an independent research preprint (CC-BY-4.0) with machine-checked Lean proofs and reproducible computational artifacts, not an externally peer-reviewed journal publication.
